items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Yeah. You know what? I played that theme when I had learned to play the guitar. It was the first [Laws sings a few notes] – that was written on the guitar.
I’m looking at a date with Gunther Schuller in New York in 1966. What caught my eye on this one was Elegy for Dolphy.
